description: This Java source file defines the HttpPushClientActor class, which is an Akka actor responsible for managing HTTP push client connections, including testing connectivity, establishing connections via proxy or directly, and handling SSL handshake. It is part of a messaging connectivity module within a larger project, possibly related to Eclipse Ditto, and contains logic for connection testing, proxy handling, SSL validation, and actor lifecycle management.
